'''G-4T '''was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire. Deployed at [[Imperial base camp]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]] G-4T recognized that a Republic camp on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] was a potential threat to the Empire's [[Adegan crystal/Legends|crystal]] mines and recruited an Imperial ally to poison their climate control with his coolant and destroy their forces.<ref name="PST" />

==Behind the scenes==
G-4T first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
It is only accessible to Imperial players in the game on Ilum.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
